item.title: 6月12日のニュース：Trump Announces Iran Agreement Signing This Weekend, but Iran Denies Claim
item.description:

Japan Achieves 100% Alternative Oil Supply Routes Bypassing Hormuz Strait 4. Second-in-Command of Illegal Scout Group 'Natural' Arrested in Osaka 5. Emperor Expresses Hope for Public Understanding on Imperial Succession Discussions Before Europe Visit 6. Japan World Cup Support Video Displayed at Times Square in New York
